International applicants are directed to contact HELP. Previous third-party/estimated value removed.

requirements.general: Entry Requirements MUET Band 4 AND any of the following: A pass in STPM, with a minimum Grade C (GP 2.0) in any TWO (2) subjects; or any equivalent qualification; OR A pass in Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia (STAM) with a minimum grade of Jayyid (good) Any qualifications equivalent to Diploma (Level 4, MQF); or any equivalent qualification Matriculation/Foundation qualification with a minimum CGPA of 2.0 out of 4.0; or any equivalent qualification English Requirement (International Students) A score of 600 for Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) A score of 100 for the Online TOEFL test A score of 6.0 for International English Language Testing System (IELTS) or its equivalent
